snake.heightOrigin: sampled native plateau; measured ledge depths retained
snake.profile: full native offsets; one translation, height cropped without scaling

malad.heightOrigin: sampled native plateau; measured ledge depths retained
malad.profile: full native offsets; one translation, height cropped without scaling

round5.physicalRows: shared depth across each segment; column bandHeight is mesh extent, exposed height is cropped by the buried apron connector
round5.sourceRuns: one initial source per contour; no triangles bridging unrelated source profiles
round5.foot: hidden continuation inside the apron; exposed native samples remain unscaled
round5.sourceCropSelection: steepest native interval by median horizontal width within each rigid 80 m panel, starting at least 4 m below source plateau; no sample smoothing or compression
round5.flowStack: authored translated Snake/Malad crops, unscaled native interiors and 1.5 m flow-top connectors; local rigid panel datum excludes repeated plateau aprons; not measured Mars stratigraphy

format: version 2 (round 3). Per segment at byte offset off: a column table float32 [c][7] = (x, z, ux, uz, yTop, s, bandHeight): lip point, outward unit vector, top elevation in world y, along-lip coordinate, column band height; then int16 [c][r] t: horizontal offset of each vertex along (ux, uz) in units of 0.02 m. Vertex (col j, row i): x + ux * t, yTop - h_i, z + uz * t with h_0 = -0.6 and h_i = (i - 1) / (r - 2) * (bandHeight + footM). Pillars: procedural detached columns (x, z, yTop, height h, radius r, seed).
